_meta.purpose: Maps deterministic repo profiler surfaces to candidate CWE ids for scope selection (not detection).
_meta.review: Each surface includes a one-line rationale; adjust mappings here without code changes.

database_driver.rationale: Database client libraries imply SQL or query construction may occur.

orm.rationale: ORM usage still permits raw SQL and unsafe query assembly.

raw_sql_callsite.rationale: String-built or interpolated SQL at a call site is direct injection surface.

web_framework.rationale: HTTP handlers process untrusted input for rendering and routing.

template_engine.rationale: Template rendering can mix untrusted data into output.

serialization.rationale: Parsing serialized objects from untrusted input enables gadget chains.

subprocess_shell.rationale: Subprocess or shell invocation with external input risks command injection.

http_client.rationale: Outbound HTTP requests built from user input enable SSRF.

crypto_api.rationale: Cryptographic API misuse covers weak algorithms and hard-coded secrets.

file_path_api.rationale: File and path operations with external input enable path traversal.

authz_api.rationale: Authorization checks and permission APIs relate to access control flaws.
